title: Minimum Consecutive Cards to Pick Up
description:
You are given an integer array cards where cards[i] represents the value of the i th card. A pair of cards are matching if the cards have the same value. 
 
 Return the minimum number of consecutive cards you have to pick up to have a pair of matching cards among the picked cards. If it is impossible to have matching cards, return -1 . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 cards = [3,4,2,3,4,7]

Output:
 4

Explanation:
 We can pick up the cards [3,4,2,3] which contain a matching pair of cards with value 3. Note that picking up the cards [4,2,3,4] is also optimal.
```

 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 cards = [1,0,5,3]

Output:
 -1

Explanation:
 There is no way to pick up a set of consecutive cards that contain a pair of matching cards.
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= cards.length <= 10 5 
 
 0 <= cards[i] <= 10 6
